outcome: Hepatic artery peak systolic velocity (HA-PSV) z-scores
cohort: The study included 202 monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) pregnancies, comprising 160 normal pregnancies and 42 pregnancies affected by selective fetal growth restriction (sFGR).
finding: In pregnancies with sFGR, the HAV-ratio was significantly lower and HA-PSV z-scores were significantly increased in growth-restricted fetuses, indicating activation of the Hepatic Arterial Buffer Response (HABR) in the small fetus.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during pregnancy using fetal Dopplers.
